dispositions.reason: named defect introduced by the round-1 edit. «Den Besuch organisieren» uses the definite article exactly like «Die Oase entdecken» (same pattern: article + noun + infinitive), so all three headings are Sie-neutral again. The definite article is the normal German rendering of en «your» / ar ـك in a neutral menu heading; no meaning added or removed. It also keeps the round-1 fix: with the article the phrase refers to a specific visit (the reader's), not to hosting one, which was the defect of the bare «Besuch organisieren».

new named point, weighed against the alternatives. The only source-faithful fix is the possessive «Ihren», which round 2 removed for a named register break against the two neutral headings; the bare «Besuch organisieren» carried the round-1 hosting reading. Each of the three faithful forms has drawn exactly one reader objection, so reopening would cycle rather than converge. Of the three, the definite article is the mildest: it is the same device as «Die Oase entdecken» (no reader asked «which oasis?»), the heading sits in the visitor site menu where the only visit in question is the reader's, and the reader raised it in passing inside the shared source-flaw complaint. Closed with the current value.
